findings.source_quote: Around the world, but particularly in the United States, people seem to value rugged individualism.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafadhali badilisha kuwa: “Huko duniani kote, lakini hasa Marekani, watu wanaonekana kuthamini 'uhalisi wa kujitegemea' au 'uhalisi mkali wa mtu binafsi' (rugged individualism).” Hii inahifadhi maana ya 'rugged individualism' kama msisitizo wa kujitegemea kwa mtu binafsi badala ya kutumia 'ujamaa' iliyobadilisha maana msingi.
findings.translation_quote: Huko duniani kote, lakini hasa Marekani, watu wanaonekana kuthamini ujamaa wa kujiamini wenye nguvu.

findings.source_quote: We know from the biblical book of I Kings, that Elijah was a fiery prophet of God.
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha 'nabii mwenye hasira za kila mara' kuwa 'nabii mwenye msukumo mkubwa/nhasi wa kiu ya haki' au 'nabii mwenye uchungu na mwamko' ili kuhifadhi maana ya 'fiery' (unyofu wa huduma na msukumo, si 'hasira'). Mfano: “Tunajua ... kwamba Eliya alikuwa nabii mwenye mwamko/mwenye shauku kwa ajili ya Mungu.”
findings.translation_quote: Tunajua kutoka kitabu cha Kwanza cha Wafalme kwamba Eliya alikuwa nabii mwenye hasira za kila mara za Mungu.

findings.source_quote: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee… –2 Timothy 4:9-11.
findings.suggested_fix: Hili ni nukuu ya maandiko; hakikisha tafsiri ya kifungu hicho ni sahihi na inatafsiriwa kwa Kiswahili sahihi wa maandiko yaliyotolewa. Badilisha sentensi iliyopo kuwa: “Luka peke yake yuko pamoja nami. Mchukue Marko, na umlete nawe…” (au kutumia tafsiri ya Biblia ya kawaida ya Kiswahili inayofaa), ili kuondoa uharibifu wa maana uliosababishwa na 'wajeruhiwe'.
findings.translation_quote: Luka pekee yuko pamoja nami. Chukua Marko, na umlete nawe… – 2 Timotheo 4:9-11.

findings.location: Same paragraph (non-quoted explanatory sentence after Paul quotation)
findings.source_quote: Yet, Paul was still feeling isolated and needed the good Christian brothers, Timothy and Mark, to come and encourage him as he faced a martyr’s death.
findings.suggested_fix: Sentensi ya tafsiri sasa inapoteza maana kwa matumizi yasiyofaa ya neno 'wajeruhiwe'. Badilisha kuwa: “Hata hivyo, Paulo bado alihisi mpweke na alikuwa anahitaji ndugu wema wa Kikristo, Timotheo na Marko, wajazewe (or 'waje') ili wamtia moyo na kumsaidia wakati alipoikabili kifo cha shahidi.” (Tumia 'wamtia moyo' au 'wamtia moyo na kumtia moyo', sio 'wajeruhiwe'.)
findings.translation_quote: Hata hivyo, Paulo bado alihisi kuwa mpweke na alihitaji ndugu wema wa Kikristo, Timotheo na Marko, wajeruhiwe na kumtia moyo wakati alikabili kifo cha shahidi.

findings.source_quote: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching –Hebrews 10:25.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri ya maandiko imepunguzwa na kuwa isiyo wazi/kisicho sahihi. Badilisha nukuu kuwa toleo la Biblia la Kiswahili linalotumika kwa ufasaha, mfano: “Tusiache mkusanyiko wetu, kama baadhi wanavyokuwa na desturi; bali tuhimize kila mmoja, na hayo zaidi tunapoona siku ikikaribia.” Au tumia toleo la Biblia ya Kiswahili uliokubaliwa, ukihifadhi sehemu zote za sentensi na muundo wa kitabu (Waebrania 10:25).
findings.translation_quote: Tusikauzeni kukusanyika pamoja, kama tabia ya wengine; bali tuhimize kila mmoja; na zaidi, tunapoona siku ikikaribia – Waebrania 10:25.
